departures.name: Peter DeRosa
departures.note: 2011 entrant; absent Oct 2014. CONFIRMED switch to pathology by publication affiliations: GW Neurosurgery 2014 (PMID 25083377) -> GW Pathology 2020 (PMID 32939388) -> U Maryland Pathology 2022-23.

departures.name: Moshe Chinn
departures.note: 2013 entrant; deleted from page 2015-05/07. CONFIRMED switch to anesthesiology: GW Anesthesiology & Critical Care Medicine affiliation (PMID 33963083, 2021; 39380859, 2024).

departures.name: Justin Reagan
departures.note: 2015 entrant; left GW between Jul 2017 and Dec 2018 (stale page listed him to Aug 2018). CONFIRMED switch to radiology: MUSC diagnostic radiology current-residents page (Wayback 2019-10-19) lists him as First Year Resident 2019-20 with 'Clinical Year: George Washington University'; MUSC Radiology affiliation 2021 (PMID 33783916).

departures.name: Crystal Adams
departures.note: 2016 entrant; last 2019-20 PGY4, not on alumni list. CONFIRMED switch to anesthesiology: GW Neurological Surgery affiliation 2018 (PMID 29614361) -> GW Anesthesiology & Critical Care Medicine 2025-26 (PMID 41509883, 42171957, 42006902).

departures.name: Kristina Terrani
departures.note: 2025 entrant; PGY1 2025-26 (still listed Apr 2026), absent from live page Sep 2026. GW Neurosurgery affiliation on a paper received Feb 2026 (PMID 42084726). Not on any other roster in this study (checked U Arizona Tucson). NPPES unchanged (last update 2025-06). Outcome UNKNOWN.

problems: Kristina Terrani's outcome unknown (left after PGY1 2025-26). Exact exit date of Justin Reagan (2017-18 vs mid-2018) unknown. Babington labelled PGY6 in 2014-15 but graduated 2015. Weingarten (2007 entrant) gone before 2012 (pre-window). Alumni list spells Ross-Jordon Elliott as 'Ross-Elliott Jordon' (same person: 2017 entrant, 2024 grad; roster/NPPES spelling kept). CC-MAIN-2017-04 retried OK (no roster URL in it).

2015-2016.reason: All 9 residents bracketed (2014-15/2016-17 rosters, alumni list, MUSC roster for Reagan). 2015 intake = Reagan + Hogan = full complement of 2 (classes alternate 2/1); no 2014-15 resident is unaccounted for; Chinn's exit (May-Jul 2015) is dated by captures.
